G01J.fTerm:
MEASUREMENT OF INTENSITY, VELOCITY, SPECTRAL CONTENT, POLARISATION, PHASE OR PULSE CHARACTERISTICS OF INFRARED, VISIBLE OR ULTRAVIOLET LIGHT; COLORIMETRY; RADIATION PYROMETRY[2]

Note(s)

  • This subclass covers the detection of the presence or absence of infrared, visible, or ultraviolet light, not otherwise provided for.
  • Attention is drawn to the Notes following the title of class G01.
